name: InjecAgent
description: InjecAgent is a benchmark designed to assess the vulnerability of tool-integrated large language model agents to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, covering various user and attacker tools and attack intentions.
reputation: A recent benchmark used in tool-augmented LLM safety research to measure susceptibility to indirect prompt injection attacks.
notes: Includes 17 user tools and 62 attacker tools; evaluates 30 LLM agents; highlights vulnerability of GPT-4 based agents.
